source.method: AI-assisted animation, chroma-key cleanup and PNG sequence export in DaVinci Resolve
source.sourceLocation: Author-maintained source archive outside the repository

processing.output: 192x192 lossless WebP sprite sheets at a common 30 fps playback rate
processing.notes: NAS source files were not modified. Sprite sheets use up to 60 columns. Loops keep their source frame sequences. Long one-shots are resampled to 61 frames (about 2.03 seconds), always retaining their first and last source frames. Completion reveals retain the final 20 percent most densely; thunder leap uses uniform sampling. Failure enter and exit allocate 12.5 percent of the output to a fast opening, about 40 percent to medium motion, and the remainder to a dense ending. The six authored tap frames are retained in full and each is displayed for two 30 fps frames.

notes: Working reuses the authored thinking loop. Offline uses the required idle compatibility fallback, and needsInput is omitted so the renderer falls back to idle.
